name: io.github.theYahia/amocrm-mcp
title: amoCRM
description: amoCRM - leads, contacts, companies, pipelines, tasks, notes, unsorted inbox (Russia)

environmentVariables.name: AMOCRM_DOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: amoCRM account domain, e.g. mycompany.amocrm.ru (alias: AMOCRM_SUBDOMAIN)

environmentVariables.name: AMOCRM_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: OAuth refresh token, enables automatic token renewal

environmentVariables.name: AMOCRM_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth integration Client ID, required for token refresh

environmentVariables.name: AMOCRM_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth integration Client Secret, required for token refresh
